description:

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_dos_ghadv_2681", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%micrometer%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%grpc%') AND "value" > 0
